thread:
deploybot: Heads-up: scheduled migration `add_user_profile_jsonb` will run in 15m on release v2.19.0-db. This will take an exclusive small-lock on `users` for ~30s per shard and a backfill job (parallel shards) that we expect to run ~20-40m. Rolling deploybot policies: canary -> global. Pins: service v2.19.0 and migration tag rdb-2026-03-21.
Morgan: quick q — how big is the backfill (rows/shard)?
Samir: ~1.2M rows/shard average, but distribution skewed. We've tested on staging with sampling: full backfill ~35m with 8x workers. With ratecap to 4x workers expect 60-75m.
Riley: we should pin the client proto to avoid accidental field reads. Please pin api-client@2.19.0 in the deploy manifest.
Jess: rollback plan: 1) flip FF `user_profile_jsonb_read` -> off (instant) 2) stop backfill workers (graceful) 3) if schema apply already done, run reverse migration to drop column (requires new migration) — fallback duration ~15m once FF off.
Kuan: can we reduce exclusive lock to 10-15s by doing the ALTER as non-blocking? Postgres online alter on this column requires rewrite unless we add column nullable then backfill. Current migration does: ADD COLUMN, backfill, then SET NOT NULL. Lock only for SET NOT NULL step.
Samir: yes plan already uses: ADD COLUMN (no table rewrite), parallel backfill, then SET NOT NULL + index create (small lock). The only exclusive moment is index CREATE CONCURRENTLY is not blocking, SET NOT NULL will take a very brief lock.
Morgan: any chance of replication lag surfacing during backfill (we saw that last month)?
oncall-bot: FYI: r/w lat spikes in eu-west-1 observed earlier today but currently stable. Watch replication_lag metric on grafana panel "pg.replication.lag" and alert policy pg-lag-high.
Jess: ops checklist: 1) pin services (api + ingestion) to v2.19.0 2) set backfill ratecap to 4 workers per shard 3) enable tracing on backfill job 4) preflight canary on 1 shard then 10% shards 5) rollback verbs ready (FF+stop).
Riley: Sound good. Add a preflight holdpoint 10m before the SET NOT NULL so SRE can confirm replication and error budget.
Samir: will add a deploybot holdpoint at +45m (before final set-not-null). Command snippet I'm going to pass:
```
pg_migrate apply rdb-2026-03-21 --pin v2.19.0 --ratecap 4 --holdpoint 2700
```
Morgan: can we also add a short window note for CS so they're not surprised? (they pinged last minute last time)
Jess: already on it, drafting: "Planned user profile migration tonight 22:10 UTC. Possible short read-only window on profile edits (~<1min) during final set-not-null. CS contact: @Jess"
Kuan: one more ask — if backfill >90m, auto-fallback to throttled mode and notify #eng-oncall. Is that doable with the current deploybot hook?
Samir: yes, deploybot supports `--fallback=throttle` and alert destination `#eng-oncall`. I'll include that.
Morgan: thanks. LGTM from my side, will be online for the deploy. :thumbsup:
Riley: I can stay for the final holdpoint.
Jess: I'll post release notes and CS ping 30m before start.
deploybot: Scheduled: rdb-2026-03-21 will start at 22:10:00 UTC. Holdpoint set at 22:55:00 UTC. Pins applied: api-client@2.19.0, ingestion@2.19.0. Notifications: #eng-oncall, #customer-success.
Morgan: acknowledged.
Samir: setting run now on staging canary, will report results in 10m.
oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window 22:00-23:30 UTC. If any incidents, escalate to @Riley.
Morgan: thanks all — keep logs short in the thread, call if anything odd. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
